title: Peer block fetch: fetch task with want queue and dedup
description: Implement the fetch task: mpsc channel receives wanted CIDs from reconciliation, deduplicates, picks peer to fetch from, sends XCID, verifies CID hash on receipt, runs block through run_pipeline on success. Bounded queue, max_concurrent_fetches config. Per-peer backoff on error. Blocked on: stoa-74b450b1.
